text: {"lessons":["I sold several positions after gains, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should judge each holding by its prospects and role in the whole portfolio.","My average cost is not a guide to what a stock is worth now. I should avoid holding a losing position just to avoid admitting a mistake, or selling a winner just to lock in a gain.","Past price moves do not predict future moves. I should make deliberate decisions when I review the account rather than trade—or stay inactive—based on recent performance alone."]}
